summary: Legs B day, so dinner leans on extra rice and sweet potato for post-lift carbs. Lunch centers on the shio koji chicken bowl, and dinner brings in citrus roasted chicken thigh (new main for variety) alongside more chicken breast. Pre-workout uses the wellness-bar cottage cheese protein smoothie (tropical, no berry flavor on today's menu) plus a banana.

meals.note: Eggs and turkey for protein, oats and multigrain bread for steady carbs, banana for fiber.

meals.note: Shio koji chicken bowl as the main, a bit of extra chicken breast, black beans and wild rice round out protein and carbs.
